body: ### Related Issue **Issue:** #XXXX ### Description ### Test Procedure ### Type of Change - [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) - [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) - [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected) - [ ] ♻️ Refactor Changes - [ ] 💅 Cosmetic Changes - [ ] 📚 Documentation update - [ ] 🏃 Workflow Changes ### Pre-flight Checklist - [ ] Changes are limited to a single feature, bugfix or chore (split larger changes into separate PRs) - [ ] Tests are passing (`npm test`) and code is formatted and linted (`npm run format && npm run lint`) - [ ] I have created a changeset using `npm run changeset` (required for user-facing changes) - [ ] I have reviewed [contributor guidelines](https://github.com/cline/cline/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) ### Screenshots ### Additional Notes ---- > [!IMPORTANT] > Replace HeroUI Tooltip with shadcn Tooltip across components in `webview-ui`, updating imports, styles, and component usage. > > - **Tooltip Replacement**: > - Replace `HeroUI` Tooltip with `shadcn` Tooltip in `HomeHeader.tsx`, `QuickWinCard.tsx`, and `SettingsView.tsx`. > - Update import statements and component usage to `Tooltip`, `TooltipContent`, and `TooltipTrigger` from `shadcn`. > - **CSS and Style Adjustments**: > - Update CSS classes and styles in `index.css` and `theme.css` to align with new tooltip implementation. > - Adjust tooltip-related styles in components like `OcaProvider.tsx` and `OpenAICompatible.tsx`. > - **Component Updates**: > - Modify `button.tsx`, `hover-card.tsx`, `popover.tsx`, `progress.tsx`, and `tooltip.tsx` to use `shadcn` components. > - Ensure consistent styling and behavior across components using the new tooltip system. > > This description was created by [](https://www.ellipsis.dev?ref=cline%2Fcline&utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral) for a28e228ccbbd73485d8346f390c3342825d7adcf.
